article.title: に vs へ
article.part: Partículas y relaciones — 助詞と関係
article.chapter: Objeto y partículas centrales: を/に/で/へ — 目的語と主要助詞：を／に／で／へ

claims.summary: The Japan Foundation’s Irodori Grammar Notes describe へ as a direction particle following place expressions with motion verbs, pronounce it [e], and explicitly permit に in the example 京都へ行きたいです / 京都に行きたいです.

locator.description: PDF, Lesson 18, point 4, pp. 18–19 (PDF pp. 61–62): definition of へ, Kyoto example, stated replacement by に, and Okinawa example.
